role: Global GSI Lead, Healthcare and Life Sciences Ecosystem
jobDescription:
NVIDIA is hiring a Global GSI Lead, Healthcare and Life Sciences Ecosystem (Developer Relations Manager, GSI Partnerships). This leadership position focuses on incubating business within the Healthcare and Life Sciences ecosystem globally, with the goal of accelerating the adoption and proliferation of AI across the Healthcare and Life Sciences sectors.

What you'll be doing:
- Lead joint solution development with major GSI partners, integrating NVIDIA AI technology into their offerings and enabling new AI services.
- Develop and complete strategic go-to-market plans with Global System Integrators (GSIs) to accelerate AI adoption and drive growth in the Healthcare and Life Sciences sector.
- Drive revenue and pipeline growth by championing NVIDIA's hardware, software, and partner ecosystem in Healthcare and Life Sciences-specific solutions.
- Collaborate cross-functionally across NVIDIA and with partners to hit targets, enable GSI teams, and advance mutual thought leadership.

What they need to see:
- Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
- 12+ years in complex sales or partner business management, with 10+ years managing large Global System Integrators (GSIs) globally.
- Proven ability to build and implement complex go-to-market strategies across matrixed organizations.
- Deep domain and product expertise, including developing and launching Healthcare and Life Sciences-specific joint solutions.
- Extensive knowledge of GSI operations, enterprise computing software/services, and a track record of successful joint solutioning and GTM with partners.
- Outstanding partner and customer relationship skills; ability to influence without direct authority.
- High energy, proactive, and adaptable; strong communication skills for technical and executive audiences.
- Familiarity with modern computing techniques, AI markets within HCLS, and NVIDIA products/services.

Stand out criteria:
- Expertise in Healthcare and Life Sciences AI, Machine Learning, and Deep Learning applications.
- Experience in joint solutioning (product management background is a plus).
- Track record of driving strategic growth through partnerships.
- Experience with cloud, Generative AI, and Agentic AI.
- Proficiency in leading complex global programs and diverse customer engagements.

Compensation: $224K-$356.5K base + equity + benefits.
emphasisAreas: Healthcare and life sciences AI domain expertise — Arine (payor/health-plan data platform, 30M+ members, 45+ plans), Booz Allen (FDA/CDRH AI governance policy development, population health, vaccine supply chain analytics), TReNDS Center (GPU compute infrastructure for federated neuroimaging and genomics research), NeuroLex Labs (ML pipelines for neurodegenerative disease voice-biomarker research), Hyperbloom (clinical-trial disaster recovery for Florence Healthcare, genomics data lake, blockchain-based life-science data exchange with HIPAA/GDPR/HL7/CDISC compliance), Slalom (behavioral health demand forecasting, $2M+ healthcare application for Georgia DBHDD)

GSI operating model from both sides — at AWS, co-sold with Deloitte and Accenture as GSI partners while managing 10+ enterprise accounts; at Slalom Consulting, operated as a consulting firm partnering with Microsoft Azure to deliver joint solutions to healthcare and public sector clients; at Booz Allen Hamilton, partnered with AWS to deliver federal healthcare AI workloads; at Hyperbloom, built the full go-to-market strategy and partner co-sell motion with AWS and research organizations

GPU and accelerated computing hands-on experience — built GPU compute infrastructure for deep learning workloads at TReNDS Center for COINSTAC; runs NVIDIA RTX 4090 and RTX 5090 workstations for local LLM development using Ollama, LM Studio, and Open WebUI; deployed on AWS and Azure GPU instances for production ML workloads

Go-to-market strategy and revenue growth — founded and grew Hyperbloom from $40K investment to $1.4M ARR delivering healthcare and life-science AI consulting; led full sales cycle with teams of sales coordinators, account managers, and solutions architects; at AWS, partnered with sales teams to drive cloud AI adoption and revenue across enterprise accounts

Executive relationship building and cross-functional leadership — 13+ years leading cross-functional teams of engineers, data scientists, and business stakeholders; at AWS, built C-suite relationships to define technical and business strategies; at Microsoft, served as escalation contact for Fortune 100 deployments; at Booz Allen, collaborated across matrixed federal-contracting ecosystems

Healthcare regulatory and compliance depth — HIPAA (8+ years), contributed to AI governance policy development for FDA CDRH in response to Executive Order 14110, FedRAMP-compliant healthcare AI deployments at Booz Allen, differential privacy for PHI protection at TReNDS Center (COINSTAC), HL7/CDISC/SDTM/ADaM interoperability standards
targetAudience: Healthcare and Life Sciences leadership team responsible for growing AI adoption through Global System Integrator partnerships (Accenture, Deloitte, Wipro, and similar firms). Also relevant: partner organization leaders who manage co-sell and joint go-to-market programs. Both audiences will look for deep healthcare AI credibility, real GSI operating experience, and the ability to influence without direct authority across matrixed organizations.
additionalContext: Paul's unique fit: he has operated on both sides of the GSI relationship — as a tech vendor solutions architect at AWS (partnering with Deloitte and Accenture) and as a consultant inside Slalom, Booz Allen, and Hyperbloom (partnering with tech vendors like Microsoft and AWS). He has also personally architected GPU compute infrastructure, built healthcare AI systems at enterprise scale, and navigated federal healthcare regulatory environments. Note: Biden's Executive Order 14110 was revoked by President Trump in January 2025. Paul's CDRH governance work is real but should be described factually without claiming current regulatory impact. Note: Paul does not have hands-on experience with NVIDIA-specific products or platforms. His GPU experience is with NVIDIA consumer hardware (RTX 4090, RTX 5090) and cloud GPU instances on AWS and Azure. Note: Even if the career data shows Arine as current, use past tense — Paul is transitioning from Arine. Do not describe Arine work as ongoing.
